items.reason: The && condition wrongly excludes team admins who are not owners; changing it to || fixes the same authorization bug.
Passing raw guests instead of uniqueGuests misclassifies resubmitted existing attendees as new and sends the wrong notification.
The comment includes the same blacklist bypass caused by comparing unnormalized guest input against lowercased blacklist entries.
The unbounded server-side guests array permits excessive inserts and notification fanout, matching the missing guest-count limit.
The validation error flag is never cleared after corrected input succeeds, leaving the same stale error state.
The comment identifies the same incorrect && operator in the team admin-or-owner permission check.
The raw guests argument causes existing attendees to receive Scheduled emails instead of AddGuests emails.
The Remove email tooltip is the same hard-coded English string that bypasses translation.
Case variations bypass the blacklist because incoming guest emails are not normalized before comparison.
The comment identifies the existing-attendee deduplication portion of this issue: case-sensitive equality allows an existing address to be added again with different casing.
The handler does not deduplicate addresses within the incoming guests array, allowing duplicate attendee rows from a single request.
Concurrent requests can both pass the existing-attendee check and insert the same guest because the read and insertion lack an atomic uniqueness guarantee.
Passing the original guests array to the email helper misclassifies resubmitted existing attendees as newly added.
